title: High-DensityvSparsefNIRS_WordColorStroop_Sparse_Anderson_2025
description: This dataset contains functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) recordings collected during a word-color Stroop task using a sparse fNIRS montage. It accompanies a study comparing high-density, multi-distance fNIRS with sparse configurations for detecting task-related brain activity. The data are organized in BIDS format and are mirrored on NEMAR from OpenNeuro.
methods_description: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy data were acquired during a Word-Color Stroop task using both high-density and sparse fNIRS probe configurations. Measurements include multi-distance fNIRS signals capturing hemodynamic responses. This study compares high-density probe arrangements with conventional sparse configurations to evaluate differences in brain activity detection.

funding_references.funder_name: This project was supported by NIH NEW grant U01-EB 029856 and Boston University research funds.
